supportingSources.label: Original Sega Star Wars Trilogy instruction card

strategy.overview: Star Wars Trilogy starts its two Multiballs through Tie Fighters and the X-Wing or through F-A-L-C-O-N, while six feature lamps track the road to Darth Vader Redemption. Destroy the Tie Fighters and use the X-Wing for the main Multiball, spell F-A-L-C-O-N at the ramp for the second, and use the upper VUK for Heroic modes while the six lamps show which wizard requirement remains.
strategy.simpleOverview: Destroy all Tie Fighters, load the X-Wing at the lit ramp or upper hole, then fire through the open drop-target gap to start Star Wars Multiball. Spell F-A-L-C-O-N at the ramp for Millennium Falcon Multiball, and shoot the upper VUK twice to qualify and start a Heroic mode.
strategy.summary: Work the Tie Fighter drops until the ramp or upper VUK lights to load the X-Wing, then fire through the drop-target opening for Star Wars Multiball. Spell F-A-L-C-O-N at the ramp and start Heroic modes at the upper VUK while completing feature lamps for Darth Vader Redemption.

quickInfo.name: Star Wars Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Destroy all Tie Fighters, load the X-Wing at the lit ramp or upper VUK, and press Launch when it points through the open drop-target gap.

quickInfo.name: Millennium Falcon Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Repeat the ramp to spell F-A-L-C-O-N. During Multiball, make playfield targets until the ramp lights for the Falcon Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Heroic modes
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the upper VUK while unlit to qualify the next Heroic mode, then return there when lit to start it and follow the DMD objective.

quickInfo.name: F-O-R-C-E hurry-ups
quickInfo.summary: Complete the five F-O-R-C-E targets, then shoot the lit big hole to start the displayed roving hurry-up.

quickInfo.name: Darth Vader Redemption
quickInfo.summary: Complete all six feature lamps, then shoot the upper VUK to begin the final mode.

steps.text: Knock down all Tie Fighter targets. When Load X-Wing lights, shoot either the lit ramp or upper VUK to place a ball in the cannon.
Watch the rotating X-Wing and press the Launch button when it points at the opening in the drop targets. A successful shot through the gap starts Star Wars Multiball.
During Star Wars Multiball, shoot the ramp for the Jackpot, complete F-O-R-C-E, reload the X-Wing, and fire through the opening again for the Super Jackpot.
Outside that build, repeat the ramp to spell F-A-L-C-O-N and start Millennium Falcon Multiball. Make playfield targets until the ramp qualifies for the Falcon Jackpot.
Shoot the upper VUK while it is unlit to qualify the next Heroic mode, then return when lit to start it. Read the DMD because each Heroic has a different shot objective.
Complete F-O-R-C-E to light a roving hurry-up at the big hole. Use the six feature lamps to choose whichever Super, Falcon, Heroic, hurry-up, Han Solo, or Landspeeder requirement is still missing.

fallback.title: Falcon-and-Heroics route
fallback.when: Use this when the Tie Fighter bank or rotating X-Wing is not returning controllably.

steps.text: Repeat the ramp to spell F-A-L-C-O-N and start Millennium Falcon Multiball.
Use the extra balls to make playfield targets, then return to the lit ramp for the Falcon Jackpot.
After Multiball, use the upper VUK to qualify and start the next Heroic mode instead of forcing the Tie Fighter drops.
Collect a Super Jackpot during Star Wars Multiball and a Falcon Jackpot during Millennium Falcon Multiball.
Complete one Heroic mode and one F-O-R-C-E hurry-up.
Finish the displayed Han Solo and Landspeeder requirements; trust the six feature lamps for their current progress.
When all six lamps are complete, shoot the upper VUK to start Darth Vader Redemption.

cautions.issue: The production instruction card originally printed a launch-button skill shot that the manufacturer later removed.
cautions.response: Do not expect a launch-button skill shot; begin with the lit playfield objectives above.

cautions.issue: Star Wars Multiball's ball count can vary by ROM or setup.
cautions.response: The qualification and start do not require that number; rely on the lit state instead.
